summary: Full-stack web app: backend-first REST API with JWT auth, role-based access, and CRUD for a secondary entity, plus a basic frontend UI for auth + protected dashboard + CRUD. Includes validation/error handling, API versioning, API docs (Swagger/Postman), database schema, and optional scalability add-ons (Redis/logging/Docker).
architectural_notes: Backend-first full-stack architecture: REST API + basic frontend client
JWT-based authentication with password hashing for credential storage
RBAC with at least two roles: user and admin
Versioned API endpoints (e.g., /api/v1) with consistent error/validation approach
Database choice TBD among Postgres/MySQL/MongoDB; schema required

existing_features.title: Provide API documentation as developer assets: a Postman collection and a concise markdown reference describing authentication flow, JWT usage, RBAC rules, and CRUD methods (including example payloads and error responses).

Build a basic React (TypeScript) frontend with pages/components for: register, login, a protected dashboard, and CRUD UI for the chosen secondary entity, showing success/error messages from API responses.
Implement secure JWT handling end-to-end: token storage strategy on the frontend, token attachment to requests, logout, and expiration handling (including UI behavior when a token expires).

Organize code for scalability: establish a clear module structure for adding new domains (e.g., additional entities), and add a short scalability/deployment note in documentation tailored to the Internet Computer canister model.

Create a coherent, consistent visual theme for the frontend (colors, typography, spacing, components) appropriate for an admin/user dashboard app, and apply it across auth screens and the CRUD dashboard.
Add repository-level deliverables: a README with setup/run instructions (dfx + frontend), a brief description of available APIs, and how to use the included Postman collection.

Extend the Task data model to support richer task metadata: priority (low/medium/high), optional due date, and optional tags (list of text labels). Ensure existing task CRUD continues to work for previously created tasks (backward compatible defaults).

Update the Tasks UI to allow users to view/edit the new fields (priority, due date, tags) when creating and editing tasks, and display them in the tasks table using clear, compact UI elements (e.g., badges/labels).

Add tasks filtering and sorting controls in the Tasks panel UI (completed status filter, tag filter, due-date sort) and wire them to the new backend listing method via React Query, with loading/error states consistent with the existing pattern.
Add a simple tasks insights section to the Dashboard that summarizes task counts (total, completed, active, overdue if due dates exist), updating automatically when tasks change.
Update developer documentation assets to reflect the expanded Task model and any new backend methods and parameters (API reference markdown and Postman collection if applicable).
Remove all visible caffeine.ai watermark/branding from the website UI, including the footer referral link and any other user-facing mentions of caffeine.ai.

Remove any hardcoded caffeine.ai URL usage from the frontend and replace it with neutral/non-branded behavior (e.g., no external branding link), and update documentation to explain how to use a shorter/custom domain for the deployed site (without referencing caffeine.ai).

new_feature_requests.summary: Backend auth APIs: user registration/login with password hashing and JWT authentication
Role-based access control (user vs admin) enforced across protected endpoints
CRUD REST APIs for a secondary entity (e.g., tasks/notes/products)
API versioning plus standardized error handling and request validation/sanitization
API documentation via Swagger and/or Postman collection
Database schema and persistence layer using Postgres/MySQL/MongoDB (TBD)
Basic frontend (React/Next/Vanilla TBD): register/login UI, protected dashboard, CRUD UI, and API response messaging
Secure JWT token handling end-to-end (storage/transport considerations)
Scalable project structure for adding new modules; optional Redis caching, logging, and/or Docker deployment
Deliverables: GitHub repo with README setup, working APIs, frontend integration, docs, and scalability note
Implement user registration and login in the Motoko canister, including password hashing (with per-user salt) and issuing/verifying JWTs for authenticated sessions.
Add role-based access control (at least: user vs admin) and enforce it across protected canister methods (e.g., admin-only operations).

Implement CRUD APIs in the Motoko canister for one secondary entity (choose one and keep consistent across backend + frontend, e.g., Tasks), including list/create/read/update/delete methods scoped to the authenticated user (unless admin).
Add API versioning, request validation/sanitization, and standardized error handling across all canister APIs (authentication + CRUD).

Define and implement an internal persistence schema for users and the chosen secondary entity within the Motoko canister, including indices/lookup strategy needed for auth and per-user entity queries.

Add new/updated backend canister methods to create and update tasks including the new metadata fields, and add a listing method that supports filtering and sorting (at minimum: filter by completed status, filter by tag, sort by due date with undated tasks last). Keep the existing listTasks method available for compatibility.

If the backend task storage/state needs schema changes that affect upgrades, add/adjust a conditional backend state migration to preserve existing tasks and authorization state during canister upgrade.
Remove Caffine.ai watermark/branding from the website UI.
Update the website URL/domain to a shorter URL and remove 'caffine.ai' from the URL.

projectName: Auth + RBAC + CRUD canister APIs with a basic React dashboard and API docs
